title: A public home for Horatio
text: Release notes, development priorities and progress updates now have a home of their own. Follow the work here and bring questions or ideas to the community discussions.

title: Making room for images
text: Image transport was being counted as conversation text, which could crowd out the actual request. The latest repair separates visual and text allowances. Local checks passed; real attachment delivery is the next verification step.

title: Less duplication, clearer history
text: The backup workflow now avoids redundant copies of application data. Release history and staging checkpoints are organized so future changes can be reviewed and traced more clearly.

title: Useful work over more machinery
text: The immediate priority is observing whether background work reaches useful outcomes. That means checking follow-through, evidence access and corrections before adding another major system.
